accountDeletion.title: Delete account
accountDeletion.description: Schedule permanent deletion of your account and app-controlled data.
accountDeletion.warningBody: Deletion is not immediate. Profiley schedules it 30 days after your request so you have time to cancel it from Settings.
accountDeletion.confirmHint: Submitting this request hides your public profile immediately and starts the 30-day grace period.
accountDeletion.pendingDescription: Your account is scheduled for permanent deletion unless you cancel this request before the deadline.
accountDeletion.publicHiddenNote: Your public profile is hidden during the grace period.
accountDeletion.publicHiddenPending: Your public profile was already hidden when this request was scheduled and remains unavailable during the grace period.

feedback.scheduled: Account deletion scheduled. You can cancel it from Settings during the next 30 days.
feedback.cancelFailed: Could not cancel the deletion request.
feedback.confirmationRequired: Type DELETE exactly to confirm the request.

dataExport.title: Export your data
dataExport.description: Download the account data Profiley currently associates with you.
dataExport.body: The export is generated on demand as a machine-readable JSON bundle with a manifest and table data for your Profiley account, profile, documents, conversations, and related records.
dataExport.hint: If you also need stored document files or another privacy right, contact privacy@profiley.ai.

feedback.ready: Your data export is ready and has started downloading.
feedback.failed: Could not prepare your data export.
